title_zh: 约好先检查旧刺绣布料再决定清洁

scenario.label_zh: 询问旧刺绣布料的保护与检查安排
scenario.goal_zh: 说明旧刺绣布料的脆弱情况，并约定保持原状等待专业检查

context_zh: 顾客带着家传刺绣布料到纺织品保护工作室咨询。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: This embroidered cloth belonged to my grandmother. Can you remove the stain?

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Possibly, but the fabric is very delicate. May I look at it without unfolding it further?

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Yes. I was tempted to try a strong stain remover.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Please do not. An unsuitable chemical can be destructive, especially when we do not know the dye.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I am worried it will deteriorate while I decide what to do.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Let us first arrange a condition assessment. I have an opening on Thursday; until then, leave it as it is in this box.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Thursday is fine. I will keep it in the box and wait for your assessment before choosing any cleaning treatment.
